title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-14
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording captures a peak February 1970 Dead show with a smoking Dark Star, The Eleven and explosive drummers.
ai_review.review: The 2/14/70 performance is consistently praised as one of the band’s finest transitional shows – highlights include High Time, Alligator, a classic Dark Star, St. Stephen → The Eleven → Lovelight sandwich and an incendiary drum section. Charlie Miller’s remastered soundboard source is clear and “extra‑crispy,” though the early set suffers from a few missing edits. Overall the music and audio quality combine for a must‑hear experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Majority of reviews are 5‑star, many detailed praises of both performance and soundboard quality; only one low rating unrelated to the music.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered by Charlie Miller – clear, crisp mix with “extra‑crispy” fidelity. Early‑show has missing portions (beginning of St. Stephen and The Eleven) and occasional glitches, but overall very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two shows (early concise set and later expansive three‑set blowout) flow smoothly; strong transitions especially in the electric second set and the classic Dark Star/Eleven/Lovelight sandwich.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for fluid, perfect guitar tone and soaring solos throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers described as “on point” and “explosive,” with post‑drum sections highlighted as a peak moment.
